description: Noviq is a multidisciplinary student team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We bring together skills in programming, UI/UX design, research, data analysis, and creative problem-solving.
summary:
ECO PULSE is a mobile application designed to investigate climate and environmental changes across Egypt using NASA Earth observation data. It monitors long-term trends in key environmental indicators, including temperature, rainfall, soil moisture, vegetation cover, evapotranspiration, and water storage.

The application helps users identify environmental changes, understand their possible causes, and explore their current and potential future impacts on agriculture, water resources, ecosystems, and local communities.

Additionally, ECO PULSE integrates OpenAI to provide an interactive AI assistant that allows users to ask questions, receive explanations, and gain further insights about climate trends, environmental changes, and their impacts.

Our goal is to make Earth observation data more accessible and help people better understand the changing environment in Egypt.
details:
ECO PULSE is an interactive environmental monitoring platform designed to help users understand and explore climate change and environmental challenges across Egypt.

The project collects and analyzes Earth observation data from NASA and other scientific sources, focusing on key environmental indicators such as temperature, rainfall, soil moisture, vegetation health, evapotranspiration, and water storage.

It transforms complex scientific data into understandable visual information through interactive charts and an interactive Map of Egypt, allowing users to explore different governorates, compare environmental conditions, and identify changes over time.

The application also introduces several interactive features:

  • AI Chatbot: An AI-powered assistant integrated with OpenAI that helps users understand environmental information and answer questions related to climate and environmental changes.
  • Community: A space where users can share knowledge, discuss environmental challenges, and exchange ideas.
  • Interactive Charts: Visual representations of environmental indicators that make patterns and long-term trends easier to understand.
  • Egypt Map: A geographical exploration tool that helps users compare environmental conditions across different regions.

ECO PULSE aims to bridge the gap between scientific data and public understanding by making environmental information more accessible and useful. It can support environmental awareness and help users recognize the possible impacts of climate change on agriculture, water resources, ecosystems, and local communities.

The application was developed using Flutter and Dart, with APIs for data integration and visualization components for presenting scientific results. OpenAI technology was also integrated to provide AI assistance.

What makes our project creative is the combination of NASA Earth observation data, geographical exploration, scientific visualization, artificial intelligence, and community interaction in one platform.

Our vision is to turn environmental data into meaningful knowledge that encourages awareness, understanding, and informed environmental decisions.
